environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no WAF attached). The Flask web tier accepts OAuth callbacks directly from the internet on port 443. No additional input validation or URL filtering is applied at the infrastructure level. Redis is accessible within the VPC on default port.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default HTTPS listener, no WAF association
config.network: Public subnet with internet-facing ALB, private subnet for workers
